item.title: Spain vs. Argentina 2026: Here’s How to Watch Spanish-Language Broadcast FIFA World Cup Final Live Online
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Theme music fades out]
Host: "Welcome to our special episode! This Sunday, July 19th, the world will be watching as the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final kicks off at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. The top two national teams, Spain and Argentina, will battle it out for the coveted FIFA World Cup Trophy.
[Short music transition]
Host: "So, when and where can you catch the action? The match starts at 3 p.m. ET/12 p.m. PT, and you can watch it live on Telemundo for the Spanish-language broadcast. But that's not all - before the match, Jennifer Hudson will perform the U.S. national anthem, and singers Nicole Scherzinger, Laura Pausini, and Robbie Williams will also take the stage. And if that's not enough, Madonna, Shakira, Justin Bieber, and BTS are set to perform at halftime!
[Short music transition]
Host: "Now, if you don't have a cable subscription, don't worry! You can still watch the World Cup Final online for free. Services like DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV, and others offer free trials for new and returning subscribers. With DirecTV, you can stream on up to three devices at the same time and record your favorite shows and sports with unlimited cloud DVR.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Alternatively, you can also watch the World Cup Final on Peacock, the official streaming home for Telemundo's Spanish-language broadcast. Plans start at $10.99 per month, and you can even save 17% with an annual plan.
[Theme music fades in]
Host: "So, there you have it! All the details you need to catch the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final on Sunday. Don't miss out on the excitement - tune in and cheer on your favorite team!"
[Theme music continues to play until the end of the episode]
